summary: The default book graph — protected more by inertia than by product quality.
moat: Goodreads' moat is a large social graph of readers, shelves, and a deep back-catalog of user reviews owned by Amazon, plus integration with the dominant bookseller. Its exposure is a widely criticized, stagnant product and a younger audience migrating to newer reading communities where AI recommendation could erode the discovery advantage.

challengers.name: The StoryGraph
challengers.evidence: The StoryGraph grew to millions of readers by 2024, positioning algorithmic mood/pace recommendations against Goodreads.
